Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains provisions for the administration of tribal areas in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram?
e: The Sixth Schedule (Articles 244(2) and 275(1)) covers tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram; the Fifth Schedule covers scheduled areas in other states.

q: Find the next number in the series: 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, ?
e: The differences are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 (doubling), so the next term is 17 + 16 = 33.

q: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which of the following Indian states?
e: The Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram — not Odisha.

q: Which instrument is used to measure the relative humidity of the atmosphere?
e: A hygrometer measures humidity; a hydrometer measures the density of liquids, a barometer atmospheric pressure and an anemometer wind speed.

q: Which default port number is used by HTTPS?
e: HTTPS uses port 443 by default; 80 is HTTP, 21 is FTP and 25 is SMTP.

The Lorenz curve is used to represent:
o: inequality in the distribution of income
the rate of inflation over time
the relationship between output and cost
the money supply in an economy
e: The Lorenz curve shows the cumulative share of income held by cumulative shares of the population, measuring income inequality (the basis of the Gini coefficient).

q: If 1 January 2023 was a Sunday, what day of the week was 1 January 2024?
e: 2023 is not a leap year: 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 odd day, so 1 January 2024 was one day after Sunday — Monday.
